project: Team-building poster for a customer care (call centre) team, featuring a person. Date, time, venue, activity and organiser are NOT known yet: the layout keeps a labelled, empty gap for them.
audience: Advocates and team leads on the customer care floor, walking past in a corridor or sitting in the break room; they know each other and the queue, not yet the event
one_message: Team building is time off the phones, with the people you share the queue with.
action: Note when and where it is, and come
format: a3 (corridor and break room); ig-portrait for the team chat
seen_from: 2 m in a corridor for about 3 seconds; closer in the break room; a phone in the team chat
tone: Warm, plain, a bit playful. An invitation, not a summons.
direction: Two drawn colleagues, waist up, meet in a high five at the centre of the orange ring; the ring frames the hands. A labelled write-in strip at the foot holds the facts still to come.
must_not: an invented date, time, venue, activity, organiser or name
the company logo redrawn by hand
anything about members, patients or callers

copy.headline: Headsets off. Hands up.
copy.support: Time away from the queue, with the people who share it.

copy_rank.1_stop: Headsets off. Hands up. (with the high five in the ring)
copy_rank.2_stay: Time away from the queue, with the people who share it.
copy_rank.3_act: When / Time / Where (labelled gaps, filled when the facts arrive)
copy_rank.4_who: Team building (kicker). Organiser unknown; left off until supplied.

Who is organising, if it should be credited
